One complete full-body figure only, neutral alert idle, three-quarter side view facing screen RIGHT, same shallow elevated2.5D viewing convention as the references. Entire crown, fingers and soles inside the image with generous magenta margins. Flat solid pureMAGENTA#FF00FF backdrop, no floor, cast shadow, vignette, labels, frames, UI, scenery or effects.

Use reference1 only for the project's coarse uneven black ink contours, broad warm/cool painted masses and compact readable cartoon anatomy. Reference2 is actual game camera/context only. Reference3 is isolated ink/proportion construction only. Invent a NEW stone enemy identity; do not turn the human's bell helmet/brown leather outfit into a stone recolor.

A broad, squat, heavy stone sentinel with a short thick neck, blunt slab helmet and stepped stone shoulder plates; very small recessed AMBER eye window cut inside a dark crack, a few large structural fractures, one restrained muted olive moss tuft on the far shoulder. Charcoal-grey/slate-neutral stone planes with warm dusty highlights, dark seams, broad readable edges. Large blocky rounded gauntlets and short rooted stone boots. Body silhouette wider and heavier than the small human; design for about1.4x the hero visible height as an ART CANDIDATE, not a changed collision definition. Current Guard collision remains halfX40/halfY28; final sprite size must be measured against the actual camera.

BODY IDENTITY ONLY: both near and far hands visibly closed, low relaxed ready fists near the belly, thumbs wrapped over closed fingers; no open hands. No axe, haft, blade or detached item anywhere. The character will wield one separately authored heavy stone axe later, with actual measured fist/shaft anchors. Empty fists are deliberate so the canonical body identity does not bake a weapon into every action. Show both closed gauntlets clearly without claiming a bone/grip coordinate.

This is the slow planted AXE-SWEEP-and-STOMP Guard. Avoid the charging Stone Knight's tall pointed knight helmet, lance-like weapon, running lean, long stride, wheels or charge pose. Use few broad stone cracks; no photoreal chipped texture, tiny gravel noise, metallic knight armor, spiked skull tropes, glowing full-body cracks, smoke, floating rubble or extra combat effects. Identity must read at future visible101px in a1280x720 game view.

This single image is an identity candidate only. Do not draw an animation strip, weapon prop, attack pose, turnaround sheet or multiple figures.
